sections.title: Contributors to population change in Harrogate
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component, %

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Harrogate, between 2025 and 2028:

  • More deaths than births meant that the population decreased by 6,461 people (−3.9%). In total, there were 12,749 births and 19,210 deaths in Harrogate between 2025 and 2028.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in England) increased the population by 15,932 (9.6%). There were 96,368 people entering the area and 80,436 people leaving the area between 2025 and .
  • Net cross-border migration (between UK nations) led to a fall in the local population in Harrogate of 969 people (−0.6%), as a result of 3,211 people entering the area and 4,180 people leaving the area between 2025 and 2028.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Harrogate's population of 1,591 (1.0%).as a result of 8,018 people entering the area and 6,428 people leaving the area between 2025 and 2028.
